app TypedScenarioValues
Given
 Counter { count:int=1 }
 policy Counter read=public
When
 crud Counter by=members fields=count
 ## Reads after each set use the staged record and native integer arithmetic.
 scenario increment(counter:Counter,delta:int) -> int by=members
  do
   set counter {count=counter.count+delta}
   return counter.count
 scenario twice(counter:Counter) -> int by=members
  do
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
   return counter.count
 ## Omitted result syntax compiles to explicit void metadata.
 scenario finish(counter:Counter) by=members
  do
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
 scenario rollback(counter:Counter,accept:bool) -> int by=members
  do
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
   require accept
   return counter.count
 scenario echo(value:int) -> int by=members
  do
   return value
 ## Bound source defaults run only for omission; explicit null and empty stay supplied.
 scenario boundNullable(counter:Counter,value:int?=counter.count) -> int? by=members
  do return value
 scenario boundArray(counter:Counter,values:int[]=[counter.count]) -> int[] by=members
  do return values
 ## Ordinary reads run source omission defaults over viewer-projected native records.
 scenario readBound(counter:Counter,values:int[]=[counter.count]) -> int[] by=members read=true
  do return values
 ## Newly created bindings read native values and observe their staged update.
 scenario born() -> int by=members
  do
   create Counter {} as counter
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
   return counter.count
 ## Field reads change provisionally; an existing reference keeps its admitted version.
 scenario observedVersion(counter:Counter) -> int by=members
  do
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
   set counter {count=counter.count+1}
   return counter.version
 scenario discard(counter:Counter) by=members
  do
   delete counter
Then
